caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The chair is illustrated in a simple, straightforward manner, with a brownish-yellow color dominating its frame, accented with red trim along the seat and parts of the backrest. The seat is rectangular, while the backrest features two horizontal slats, with the topmost slat being slightly curved and decorative. The chair appears to have four legs, and all structural elements are outlined with a dark line. No other objects or patterns are present in the composition. The artist's name, "Mildred Ferg," is written in small letters in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Toy Chair
